subject: Latency-first deployment recommendation and pilot ask
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@noblemart.com>, Priya Desai <p.desai@noblemart.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Jan 2028 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Latency-first deployment recommendation and pilot ask

Hi Sanjay / Priya —

Thanks again for the 45-minute discovery today. Short recap from our side plus a clear next step so we can move to a short pilot: 

What we heard from NobleMart
- Target p99 for your customer-facing generator endpoint: ~70ms for short responses, allowances to 120ms for long multimodal responses.
- Sustained QPS: ~120 req/s, with bursts to ~400 req/s during peak shopping events.
- Typical request: ~128 tokens, models under consideration: quantized Llama2-70B and a smaller 13B option for low-latency variants.
- Data residency: primary requirement is EU region; no air-gap requirement today but compliance review pending.

Initial recommendation (latency-prioritized)
- Start with a Dedicated capacity pilot sized for baseline 120 QPS and burst autoscaling to handle 400 QPS. Dedicated gives predictable p99 latency vs. shared Hosted pools.
- Configure a small warm pool (pre-warmed workers) + aggressive KV cache for common prefixes to hold p99 under 80ms for short completions.
- If data residency or compliance tightens, we can transition to Private VPC with the same runtime config and an identical rollout policy.

Ask / next step
- Permission to run a 2-week Dedicated pilot (staging -> production shadow) so we can collect real p95/p99 and cost-per-token under your traffic patterns.
- Share a 24-hour sample of production traffic (anonymized) or a representative QPS schedule and token histogram — that will let us right-size the pool.

Attached: pilot proposal + estimated pricing sheet for a baseline Dedicated pool.

If that plan sounds good I’ll loop in Engineering for a kickoff and propose dates (we can start as early as next Monday).

—Olga
Olga Petrov | Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@noblemart.com>

Subject: Re: Latency-first deployment recommendation and pilot ask

Thanks Olga — useful recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) The 70ms p99 is our "baseline" UX target for single-turn text completions (search-autocomplete, short product copy). For multi-step or multimodal flows (image + text) the product team is comfortable up to 120ms p99.
2) The 120 QPS is what we see daily across EU at the moment; during promotions (Black Friday-like sale events) the 400 QPS bursts are plausible but short (10–30 minutes).
3) We can export a 24-hour anonymized sample — will scrub PII and provide histogram of token lengths and per-minute QPS by EPOCH. Expect that by EOD tomorrow.

Pilot: we’re supportive of a 2-week Dedicated pilot. Can you confirm:
- Will there be a hard SLA for latency during the pilot?
- How disruptive is transition back to Hosted if we need to step down after the pilot?

Also cc'ing our platform lead Priya (she's looped in for security/compliance).

Thanks,
Sanjay
Sanjay Rao | Head of Product | NobleMart

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@noblemart.com>, Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Jan 2028 16:00:12 -0800
Subject: Re: Latency-first deployment recommendation and pilot ask

Sanjay — happy to confirm details and put numbers to the ask. Quick responses below and a short cost sketch (see attached pricing sheet):

Pilot SLA and rollback
- Pilot: we will instrument a soft SLO for p95/p99 latency (observable in Redwood Console) and a joint runbook to escalate if p99 exceeds thresholds. For a short pilot we don’t switch contractual SLAs, but we provide an operational target and a follow-up SLA checklist if you decide to purchase Dedicated.
- Rollback to Hosted: low friction. The same API and model pins are used across Hosted/Dedicated/Private. If we step down after the pilot, we can reroute traffic to Hosted with a two-step cooldown (drain Dedicated, enable Hosted route). There is a brief performance delta — we’ll share expected delta given your traffic sample.

Sizing notes (how we right-size Dedicated)
- Baseline pool: size for 120 sustained QPS with headroom for 1.5x sustained (safety margin).
- Autoscaling: burst autoscale configured for up to 400 QPS with pre-warm policy for known sale windows.
- Optimizations: prefix/KV caching plus quantized model variant for <80ms p99 on short completions. If you need sub-50ms, we recommend shorter sequence models or additional GPU tiering.

Cost sketch (see attached)
- Pilot estimate: cost for 2-week Dedicated pilot (engineering time + reserved nodes with autoscale) — see price sheet. We can apply a one-time pilot credit off the first committed month if we move to a subscription.

Next: Olga to schedule a kickoff with Eng. Priya — once we have your traffic sample Ben and I will size the pool and lock a pilot window.

—Ben
Ben Carter | Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference

Attachments: 20280112-pricing-sheet.xlsx
